name: Light Step
description: Charm (Year 1). Your footsteps make no sound and leave no print for a scene. A sharp-eyed observer may still notice the dust moving.

name: Unseen Hand
description: Charm (Year 2). A invisible force carries, lifts, or pulls one small object within sight. It cannot strike a blow, but it can turn a key or pull a rope.

name: Mending Word
description: Charm (Year 1). A tear, crack, or break in a mundane object closes cleanly. The repair is visible on close inspection and cannot restore something missing.

name: Borrowed Voice
description: Charm (Year 3). Your voice comes from a spot you can see for a scene. It says what you say, but it cannot make a sound you could not make.

name: Tidy Room
description: Charm (Year 1). One room puts itself in order: beds made, books shelved, spills gone. It cannot sort what belongs to whom, and it hides nothing.

name: Pocket Form
description: Transfiguration (Year 2). One object no larger than a satchel folds into a palm-sized version of itself for an hour. It keeps its weight and its uses.

name: Soften Stone
description: Transfiguration (Year 3). A patch of stone or brick becomes clay-soft for a scene. It can be dug, shaped, or pushed through, then hardens again.

name: Borrowed Shape
description: Transfiguration (Year 4). You take the shape of one mundane animal for a scene. You keep your mind, but not your voice, hands, or wand.

name: Iron Feather
description: Transfiguration (Year 3). A light object becomes heavy as iron for a scene. It does not become stronger, so a rotted beam may break under its own new weight.

name: Fold Space
description: Transfiguration (Year 5). Two doorways you can see become the same doorway for a breath. Anything crossing one arrives at the other. The fold closes with a sound like a book snapping shut.

name: Threshold Sigil
description: Warding (Year 2). A doorway, window, or gate bears a sigil that warns you when something crosses it. The warning is a chime only you hear.

name: Alarm Bell
description: Warding (Year 1). A small bell sounds in your ear when a named person or creature enters a room you warded. It cannot tell you why they came.

name: Reflection Ward
description: Warding (Year 3). The next spell or hex aimed at you turns aside and marks the caster with a flash. It does not stop a physical blow.

name: Sealed Letter
description: Warding (Year 1). A letter or page can be read only by its named recipient. Anyone else sees a blank page and feels the seal warm.

name: Safe Room
description: Warding (Year 4). One room becomes hard to find or enter for a scene. People who mean you harm lose their way; people who mean you well find the door.

name: Fragment Sight
description: Divination (Year 2). You see a broken image of a place you have touched within the last day: one angle, one moment, no sound. The image is true but incomplete.

name: Ink Answer
description: Divination (Year 1). Ink writes a short answer to one question on a page. The answer is true but terse, and it may answer a different question than you meant.

name: Weather Ear
description: Divination (Year 1). You know the weather for the next day and whether a storm, frost, or heat is coming. You can also hear a storm coming an hour before it arrives.

name: Truth Thread
description: Divination (Year 3). A red thread appears between two people who have made a promise to each other. It shows the promise exists, not whether either means to keep it.

name: Lost Compass
description: Divination (Year 4). A compass points to the thing you have lost, not north. It points to where the thing is, not the safe way to reach it.

name: Steady Breath
description: Healing (Year 1). A person's breathing slows and steadies, and pain fades for a scene. It does not heal a wound, only make it bearable.

name: Knit Bone
description: Healing (Year 3). A broken bone sets and knits in minutes. The patient must stay still, and the bone is sore for a day.

name: Calm Fever
description: Healing (Year 2). A fever breaks and a sick person rests easily for a night. The cause of the sickness remains and may return.

name: Clear Mind
description: Healing (Year 2). A confused, charmed, or frightened mind becomes clear for a scene. The spell is obvious to anyone watching, and the cause may still be present.

name: Shared Warmth
description: Healing (Year 1). Warmth passes from you to one other person, enough to carry them through a cold night. You feel the cold in their place.

name: Whisper Mask
description: Illusion (Year 1). Your voice seems to come from someone else, or from a place nearby. A careful listener can tell the sound is borrowed.

name: False Door
description: Illusion (Year 2). A door appears where there is only wall, or a real door looks like wall. The illusion fools sight and touch, but not a hand that pushes hard.

name: Crowd of One
description: Illusion (Year 3). You appear to be one of a small crowd, or one member of a crowd appears to be you. The illusion breaks if you speak out of character.

name: Quiet Step
description: Illusion (Year 1). Your footsteps and the rustle of your clothes are muffled for a scene. A ward or a good ear can still catch you.

name: Painted Scene
description: Illusion (Year 4). A scene you imagine fills a room for a scene: a feast, a storm, a crowd. It has no smell and cannot touch anything.

name: Candle Call
description: Elemental (Year 1). A flame leaps to your hand, lights a wick, or snuffs out. It cannot spread beyond what you name.

name: Gust
description: Elemental (Year 1). A hard gust shoves one person or knocks over light objects. It is enough to stagger, not to lift a person.

name: Puddle Step
description: Elemental (Year 2). You step into one puddle or pool and out of another you can see within a hundred paces. Both must be deep enough to cover a foot.

name: Spark Arc
description: Elemental (Year 3). A arc of spark jumps from your hand to a target, shocking and distracting it. It can light a lamp, jam a mechanism, or spoil a delicate ritual.

name: Stone Song
description: Elemental (Year 3). You hear the shape of stone for a scene: hollows, cracks, old passages, and the places where it is about to fall.

name: Command the Will
description: Forbidden. You force one person to obey a single short command for a breath. The victim knows what was done, and the academy treats its use as a serious crime.

name: Sever the Thread
description: Forbidden. You cut the magical tie between two things: a ward and its anchor, a familiar and its master, a promise and its keepers. The cut is permanent and always leaves a mark.

name: Borrowed Years
description: Forbidden. You take years from your own future to buy power now. The GM decides what the debt looks like and when it comes due.

name: Hollow Name
description: Forbidden. You strip a person's name from the world's memory for a day. Friends forget them, records blur, and only you remember. The name returns, but not the trust.

name: Open the Deep
description: Forbidden. You open a way to a place that should stay closed. Something always comes through, and it is never quite what you called.
